comment: Bug 2 of the hunt of 2026-10-08. A document of 1920 by 1280, the photograph of the harness's references imported as a layer, and an effect layer called Kaleidoscope made above it, reading it, with the kaleidoscope attached at eight mirrors. A look and a shot, the photograph under its kaleidoscope and the Layers docker. Then the photograph is deleted, a layer called Paint is added and a red stroke painted across the canvas: the look shows the grey background and the stroke alone, the run log holds no script error, and the shot shows the effect row saying No input. Three undos take back the stroke, the new layer and the delete, and the look shows the photograph under its kaleidoscope again. The texels read are the centre, where every wedge meets, a point the kaleidoscope folds from elsewhere, and a point on the red stroke.
